# COMPANY & PROJECT OVERVIEW

## Company
- Name: AIVision21
- Tagline: "Provides Insights. Exemplifies Learning."
- Experience: 30+ years in HR, Talent Acquisition and Learning & Development
- Focus: AI-powered products across 21 domains for 21st century needs
- Logo: https://i.ibb.co/s9CvkVdd/aivision21-logo.png

## Product
- Name: EduVision
- Suite: LearningVision by AIVision21
- Tagline: "Your Career Growth Companion"
- Type: Student Career Growth Platform
- Version: 1.0

## What Is EduVision
EduVision is NOT a course website or LMS. It is a complete AI-powered career preparation platform that combines 5 tools in one app:
1. Resume Builder — Build and AI-improve resume step by step
2. Test Preparation — Create, take and analyze mock tests with AI-generated questions
3. AI Interview — Practice interviews with AI interviewer "Aria" in a safe judgement-free space
4. Skill Tracker — Track skills, certifications and identify skill gaps for target role
5. Expert Network — Find and book sessions with real human industry experts

## Who Uses EduVision
- Primary users: Indian college students aged 18-24
- Profile: Final year students and placement aspirants
- Primary device: Desktop
- Secondary device: Mobile (responsive)
- Mindset: Anxious about placements, overwhelmed, needs direction, needs small wins and motivation

## Why EduVision Exists
Indian students face intense placement pressure with no structured guidance. EduVision gives them one platform that combines everything they need — resume, tests, interview practice, skills tracking and expert mentorship. The AI layer personalizes everything to their target role and timeline.

## Brand Promise
Every student who uses EduVision should feel: "I know what to do next to get placed. I am making progress today."

## Key Differentiators
- AI-powered personalization
- Gamification with XP, levels and streaks
- Safe judgement-free practice environment
- Built for Indian student context
- All-in-one platform
- Progress visible everywhere

LAYOUT — NON NEGOTIABLE RULES
=============================================================

RULE 1: DESKTOP FIRST
  Primary layout = 1280px desktop

  Whole app sits inside rounded container:

    margin: auto

RULE 5: ICON-ONLY SIDEBAR ALWAYS VISIBLE
  Width: 64px
  Always visible on desktop
  NO hamburger toggle needed
  NO text labels — icons only

APP SHELL STRUCTURE:

BADGE/CHIP:
  padding 4px 10px, border-radius 9999px, font 12px weight 600
  primary: bg #FDF2F2, text #BD1313, border #F5BFBF
  success: bg #DCFCE7, text #16A34A, border #86EFAC
  warning: bg #FEF3C7, text #D97706, border #FCD34D
  error:   bg #FEF2F2, text #DC2626, border #FECACA
  neutral: bg #F1F5F9, text #475569, border #E2E8F0
  dark:    bg #0F172A, text white

PROGRESS BAR:
  Track: #F5BFBF
  Fill: >=80% = #16A34A | 50-79% = #BD1313 | <50% = #DC2626
  Animate from 0% on mount: 800ms ease-out
  Heights: 4px compact / 6px standard / 8px prominent

EMPTY STATE:
  Always: illustration + title + description + CTA button
  Use imgbb illustration URLs
  Title: encouraging never negative
  Background: soft module color

TOAST:
  Fixed top-center, bg #0F172A, text white
  Pill shape radius 9999px
  Entry: toastEnter 350ms spring, auto-dismiss 3000ms
  XP Toast: bg linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706, #B45309)
            text white "+50 XP 🎉", position top-right, 2500ms

CIRCULAR PROGRESS:
  SVG stroke animation on mount
  Track #F5BFBF, fill score-based color
  Center: value + label
  Sizes: 64px / 80px / 120px

=============================================================
ANIMATIONS — DEFINE ALL IN GLOBAL CSS
=============================================================

@keyframes screenEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes fadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
}

@keyframes floatSlow {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-12px) rotate(3deg); }
}

@keyframes spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.12); opacity: 0.8; }
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

@keyframes toastEnter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-60px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes circleDraw {
  from { stroke-dashoffset: 283; }
  to { stroke-dashoffset: var(--circle-offset); }
}

@keyframes confettiFall {
  0% { transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(80px) rotate(360deg); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes countUp {
  from { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

@keyframes slideInLeft {
  from { transform: translateX(-100%); }
  to { transform: translateX(0); }
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  from { transform: translateY(100%); }
  to { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes badgePop {
  0% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; }
  60% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

.screen-enter {
  animation: screenEnter 280ms ease-out both;
}

.skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F1F5F9 25%, #E2E8F0 50%, #F1F5F9 75%, #F1F5F9 100%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.8s linear infinite;
}

.inner-scroll {
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #F5BFBF transparent;
}
.inner-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
.inner-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #F5BFBF;
  border-radius: 9999px;
}

ANIMATION RULES:
  Every screen switch: screenEnter 280ms
  Stat numbers: count up from 0 on mount
  Progress bars: fill from 0% on mount
  Circular progress: draw stroke on mount
  Cards hover: translateY(-3px) + shadow
  Buttons hover: translateY(-2px) + shadow
  Buttons active: scale(0.97)
  3D illustrations: float animation always
  Charts: recharts built-in animation
  Badges unlock: badgePop + confetti
  Only animate: opacity, transform, filter
  NEVER animate: width, height, top, left, padding, margin

=============================================================
UX PRINCIPLES
=============================================================

  One primary CTA per screen — always visible
  Break forms into wizard steps max 7 steps
  Show progress everywhere
  Strengths BEFORE weaknesses always
  Celebrate every win with toast + animation
  Action buttons: "Build Resume" NOT "Continue"
  AI Interview = "Practice Mode" always
  Every screen answers: "What do I do next?"
  Empty states: always encouraging + CTA button

=============================================================
COPY AND TONE
=============================================================

  Voice: Smart Friend — warm, encouraging, direct
  Use: "Let's" "You've got this" "Great work"
  Never: "Error" "Failed" "Invalid" "Unfortunately"
  Reframe: "Test failed" → "Keep practicing! 🚀"
  Always encouraging, never negative

=============================================================
RESPONSIVE (SECONDARY — DESKTOP FIRST)
=============================================================

  Min width: 360px
  Breakpoints: 768px / 1024px / 1280px

  ON MOBILE max-width 767px:
    Sidebar hidden, show bottom navigation 5 items
    3-column layout → single column
    Stat cards → 2x2 grid
    Action cards → vertical stack
    All inputs minimum 16px font
    All tap targets minimum 44x44px

=============================================================
DARK MODE (SECONDARY — TOGGLE ONLY)

  Trigger: Settings toggle
  Store: localStorage eduvision-theme
  Apply: data-theme="dark" on html element

    Page BG:     #0F172A

PERFORMANCE
=============================================================

  Animate only: opacity, transform, filter
  Import icons individually from lucide-react
  Lazy load below-fold illustrations
  Recharts animation off on mobile
  Use will-change on sidebar and modals

=============================================================
ACCESSIBILITY
=============================================================

  Never remove focus outlines
  Custom focus: 3px solid rgba(189,19,19,0.4)
  All icon buttons: aria-label required
  Progress bars: role="progressbar" + aria values
  Modals: role="dialog" + aria-modal + focus trap
  Toasts: role="alert" + aria-live
  Color never only indicator of state
